Environment overrides require policy.environment and known keys. Parse boolean only from exact true/false strings; parse integers only from signed decimal strings. Return {ok, config, error}; failures have empty config, successes have null error. Preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings.
Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.
